UserSaves.title: UserSaves
UserSaves.description: Legacy character sheet save data preserved for reference and optional import

GrimoireSave.title: GrimoireSave
GrimoireSave.description: Compact spell randomizer state storing known spells, current rolled spells, Ring of Spell Storing entries, and custom per-level randomizer rules

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

knownSpellNames.description: List of always-known permanent spell names (max 400)

rolledSpellNames.description: List of currently active randomized spell names (max 100)

ringSpells.description: Spells currently stored inside a Ring of Spell Storing (max 5 entries totaling up to 5 spell levels)

spellSlots.description: Spell slot tracking state (useCustomMax flag, max slots, expended slots, and temporary Flexible Casting bonus slots per level 1-9)

sorcery.description: Sorcery points and pinned Metamagic options (useCustomMax, maxPoints 0-30, usedPoints 0-30, knownMetamagics up to 15)

concentrationSpell.description: Name of the spell currently holding Concentration, or null when not concentrating

rollHistory.description: Recent rolled spell snapshots for undo and restore (max 8 entries)

config.description: Randomizer rules including casterLevel, maxSpellLevel, canRitualCast, levelCounts, classWeights, multiClassRule, schoolWeights, and component exclusions

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync

users/{userId}.description: Legacy user character data preserved read/write for backwards compatibility

grimoireSaves/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated spell randomizer state synced across devices
